_summary: FAIL: 3 blockers, 7 majors, 5 minors. The blockers are two F26 elements (hours worked; the NY/PA working-day counts) and 13 RESEARCH-GAP markers that fail the v2.12 C29 hard list. Clean: structure, source tiers, tag-to-fact (period-aware, 205/205) and the mapper code lists. On the RSPEC side of C27, 148 rows are still forward references and must be re-pointed in this round. F44: 119 of 126 keys verified against the local copy of the bound row(s); 7 unverified (4 already with the source hunter, 3 new).

findings.problem: 'Hours worked (time-data input)' is per-pay-period time data (G52: 'captured from the time and attendance data for each pay period ... accumulated by the report generator'). Builder judgement call 3 REJECTED: this is the Canada F26 case (EI insurable hours by pay period removed from the DD). The approved RSPEC already classifies the same concept as a payroll result: US-WC-001 row 3 'Hours worked ... in the period' = NOT-DD in rspec_dd_recon.csv, while US-UI-001 row 11 maps it to the DD. The same concept is classified two ways.
findings.expected: Delete Country Fields row 52 in dd_defs.py. Move the 9 facts tagged in W52 (dd.wa.ui.hours_quarter, dd.mn.ui.paid_hours, dd.ma.ui.hours_work_location [hours part], dd.ct.ui.occupation_hours_zip [hours part], dd.ne.ui.hours_job_title, dd.de.paid_leave.hours, dd.or.form132.hours, dd.wa.pfml_ltc.employee_fields [hours part], dd.fed.aca.fte_tracking) to the build-log EXCLUDE table as 'hours = WTC unit of measure / time data, accumulated per quarter by the report'. Reword W80: drop 'the hours that support it are held in Hours worked' and write 'the supporting hours come from time data, not from this dictionary'. Re-point the 9 RSPEC rows that map to it (US-IRS-007 r6 ACA-004 -> 'ACA monthly employee status' only; US-PFML-001 r5 PFML-C-003, r33 PFML-WA-002; US-UI-001 r11 UI-C-009, r14 UI-C-012, r49 UI-CT-004, r97 UI-MA-003, r107 UI-MN-001, r185 UI-WA-001) to 'Payroll result: hours accumulated from time data (WTC unit of measure)', the same wording class as US-WC-001 r3. Re-run dd_recon.py.
findings.evidence: openpyxl read of G52, W52 and W80; rspec_dd_recon.csv rows US-WC-001 r3 (NOT-DD) and US-UI-001 r11 (MAPPED); country_failure_log.md F26

findings.problem: 'Working days in the taxing State (nonresident allocation)' (row 94) and 'Total working days in the period' (row 95) are per-period day counts from time data (G94: 'Days ... worked in the taxing State in the period'). Builder judgement call (NY/PA working days as period inputs) REJECTED under F26: a per-period count is transactional per-payrun data. No spec consumes them (dd_element_usage.csv: 0 spec rows, calculation only).
findings.expected: Delete rows 94 and 95. Keep facts dd.multi.ny_convenience_days and dd.multi.pa_working_days in the build-log EXCLUDE table as 'day counts = time data / WTC unit of measure feeding NY SIT and PA SIT allocation'. If the NY allocation needs an employee-declared estimate, it arrives with the dd.state.w4.ny fix (IT-2104.1) already with the source hunter. Do not add a field for it in this batch.
findings.evidence: openpyxl read of G94, G95 and W94; dd_element_usage.csv

findings.problem: 13 cells carry the literal marker 'RESEARCH-GAP' (e.g. W83: '... RESEARCH-GAP: the line structure of each State certificate ... (DD-RQ-01)'). In mercans_pipeline_v2_12.sh, C29 lists 'RESEARCH-GAP' as a HARD tier-1 marker (line 3118: 'verdict FAIL anywhere'). dd_lint.json reports C29 = [] because the builder lint does not use the v2.12 pattern list. The research gaps themselves (DD-RQ-01 to RQ-05) are already with the source hunter and are not re-reported. This finding covers the marker wording only.
findings.expected: In the generator, replace the marker text with the neutral form the CCG and RSPEC already use: 'Not configured in this release [[GAP:DD-RQ-0n]]'. Keep the sentence that says what is missing; drop the warning sign and the word RESEARCH-GAP. Add the v2.12 HARD list to dd_lint.py C29 (TODO, TBD, FIXME, VERIFY No, RESEARCH-GAP and ??? case-sensitive; [placeholder], [CHECK], [?], 'to be confirmed', 'to be verified' and 'lorem ipsum' case-insensitive) so the lint matches the gate.
findings.evidence: regex of the v2.12 HARD_CS list over every cell of the workbook: 13 hits, listed in location

findings.problem: The DD now exists, but 148 of the 192 RSPEC rows that cite it still read 'US-DD-001 v1.0: <free description> (forward reference)'. Example: US-DOR-001 r3 says 'employer FEIN (forward reference)', but the DD field is 'Employer Identification Number (EIN)'. Only 9 rows cite the exact DD field name; 183 resolve only through the builder's mapping rule. Script C27, run on the package, returns MANUAL with 833 unresolved, and the first hits are these DD rows. The C27 cross-check fires at DD close in both directions. Leaving the forward guesses is F25 by construction.
findings.expected: RSPEC generator (artifact-builder, as a propagation round of the approved RSPEC): after the deletions in findings 1 and 2, rewrite column L of each MAPPED row in 05-data-dictionary/_build/checks/rspec_dd_recon.csv to 'US-DD-001 v1.0: <dd_elements value: exact DD Field Name(s) separated by ' | '>' and remove '(forward reference)'. Then re-run C71 regen, spec_checks and C27. All 192 DD rows must resolve by exact name.

findings.problem: The tag value 'federal W-4 (no state certificate); NDW-R reciprocity' (Country Option Mappers, State withholding certificate block) is bound to US-NDS5-001, the 2026 rates booklet. Its local copy has 0 hits for 'NDW-R' or 'reciproc'.

findings.problem: The tag value 'motor carrier / rail / air carrier / seaman flag' (Country Fields W92 and the 'Interstate transport worker type' mapper) is bound only to US-MULTIS5-003, which is 49 U.S.C. 40116(f) on air carriers. Its copy has no 'rail', no 'seaman' and no motor-carrier text. The fact's 'note' names 11502 and 11108, but no _also_register_ids carries them, and 14503 (motor carriers) is not named at all.
findings.expected: Add '_also_register_ids': ['US-MULTIS5-001','US-MULTIS5-002','US-MULTIS5-004'] (49 USC 14503 motor carriers, 49 USC 11502 rail carriers, 46 USC 11108 seamen; each copy carries the term, checked). The value is unchanged; the builder re-runs C46 only.
findings.evidence: local copies: MULTIS5-003 has no rail or seaman text; MULTIS5-001 'motor carrier'; MULTIS5-002 'rail carriers'; MULTIS5-004 'seaman on a vessel'

findings.problem: The tag value 'MW-4 (exemption claims sent to DOR via TAP)' (Country Option Mappers E299) is bound to US-MTP51-002, the DOR news page on the 2026 tables. The copy names Form MW-4, and names TAP only in the site menu. It says nothing about exemption claims being sent to DOR, through TAP or any other way.
findings.expected: Either bind the fact to the register row of the Montana Employer and Information Agent Guide (or the MW-4 instructions) whose copy states the exemption-certificate submission rule, or reduce the value to 'MW-4'. The copy supports 'Montana Employee's Withholding and Exemption Certificate Form MW-4'. The builder then regenerates E299.
findings.evidence: local copy revenue-mt-2026-withholding-updates (5,852 chars), read in full around 'MW-4'

findings.problem: dd.oh.school_district_code is bound to US-OHS5-019, the 2025 school district list (effective_to 2025-12-31), in a 2026 dictionary. W96 says 'The cited list is the 2025 list; the changes for 2026 are not named in the cited sources'. However, the register names US-OHS5-018 as the 2026 delta, and the fact's own _also_register_ids row US-OHB5-401 (a 2026 copy) states the four-digit code rule.
findings.expected: Source hunter: make the 2026 copy the primary row for the field definition (register_id US-OHB5-401, effective_from 2026-01-01, value unchanged). Keep US-OHS5-019 and the US-OHS5-018 delta as list sources under RQ-02. Builder: then drop the '2025 list' sentence from W96.
findings.evidence: register rows US-OHS5-019 (effective_to 2025-12-31) and US-OHS5-018; the fact's _figure_located quotes US-OHB5-401

findings.problem: 'State employer account numbers' is a single Text field with the format 'Per State format'. Yet F13 says 'One value per State and programme; the State and programme are recorded with the number', and no field holds the State or the programme. A developer cannot build the multi-valued record from this row.
findings.expected: Replace row 13 with three legal-entity rows in the same block. 1) 'State employer account State', with the mapper 'US State or District (USPS code)'. 2) 'State employer account programme', with a new mapper: Withholding / Unemployment insurance / Paid leave. 3) 'State employer account number' (Text), with J = 'Per State format, e.g. UT 14 characters ending in WTH; KS 036#######F##; MD CRN; IA 9-digit permit', taken from the tagged fact. Keep the V13 tags on the account-number row, and set its F text to 'repeat the three fields once per State and programme'. Update the rspec_dd_recon mapping of the DOR, UI and PFML rows to the account-number row.
findings.evidence: openpyxl read of ID Information row 13

findings.expected: Set the code in C121 and C129 to 'blank', as in C141. D and E keep 'blank otherwise' and 'blank if Tax Jurisdiction Code (220) is P'.

findings.problem: Return-level indicators sit in a master-data sheet with nothing saying they are set per return: no social security or Medicare wages, business closed, final wage payment date, the four Form 941-X items, W-2 terminating business and W-2 resubmission. A developer will model them as standing employer values.
findings.expected: Append to each G cell: 'Entered for the return period it applies to (effective-dated per return); not a standing master value.' No row is deleted.

findings.problem: dd.state.w4.oh ('IT 4 (zero exemptions if absent)') is re-pointed through _also_register_ids to US-OHP51-002. That row has status 'superseded' with no successor row, although its copy is the current 2026 guideline (Rev. 11/25) and does carry 'the employer must withhold tax based on the employee claiming zero exemptions'. The primary row, US-OH-002, has no local copy.
findings.expected: Set US-OHP51-002 status to 'active', since it is the only held copy of the 2026 guideline. Alternatively, register a new active row for the same file and re-point the fact to it.
findings.evidence: register status column; grep of the local copy for 'zero exemptions'

findings.problem: The precheck re-point '_also_register_ids': ['US-CTP10-001'] matched 'Third Quarter' in the IP 2026-1 due-date table, which has nothing to do with the claim. The primary row carries the whole claim (CGS 31-225a(j)(1)(B); copy: 'Commencing with the third calendar quarter of 2026 ... occupation ... hours worked ... zip code of such employee's primary worksite').
findings.expected: Remove US-CTP10-001 from _also_register_ids and set _figure_located to the CGS 31-225a quote above (US-CTS5-018).
findings.evidence: grep of the US-CTS5-018 copy; _figure_located text

manual_review_items: C5 (classification cites its establishing article): not implemented in v2.12 (L3). Run by hand on the 144 elements: every Additional Notes cell cites a register row or a spec row; no element is uncited.
C6 (file format vs source PDF): not applicable to the DD, which has no file layout. Layout positions quoted in tags were checked through F44.
C7 (population-rule depth on conditional fields): run by hand. Every CM row has a non-empty pre-condition (column H / I).
Version Control C13 shows '2027-03-31' with status 'Issued'. That is the manifest planning date (package.issue_date), the same as in the approved RSPEC: an owner decision, not a DD defect.

numeric_verification.method: Text check of every [[FACT:key=value]] tag in the workbook (205 tags, 126 keys incl. 17 borrowed) against the local copy of the bound register row(s), i.e. register_id + _also_register_ids. Copies were re-extracted today with pdftotext and an HTML strip. Each value went through an element check (forms, numbers, dates, acronyms) and a content-word check; misses were read in context. Accepted on reading: the DOB, IWO, DOR and 5-digit glosses (expansions present in the copies); dd.state.w4.az '2026' (the row URL and title name the 2026 A-4 instructions); dd.state.w4.ri ('Effective January 1, 2020 ... must ... complete Form RI W-4'; 'if line E is more than 10, enter 10'). Unverified: the 4 builder-flagged keys (with the source hunter) and 3 new ones (findings 6-8). No WebFetch was used.
